visual_identity.core_identity: A dense but readable cloud of ordinary cave bats moving as one turbulent mass through confined underground air.
visual_identity.silhouette: Many small bat silhouettes arranged in a clear spiral, funnel, or directional stream with negative space between groups.
visual_identity.body_shape: Repeated small natural bat bodies in varied wing positions with no oversized leader.

scene_identity.size_impression: The swarm occupies a broad air volume while individual bats stay small and distinguishable.
scene_identity.natural_posture: Individuals remain in believable flight or roost contact; the group follows one readable flow.

known_failure_modes.correction: separate bats into readable clusters with white gaps
keep individuals similar small scale and emphasize group flow
